Maya Patel: Postmortem follow-up: two repeat patterns — cloud auth backpressure causing token refresh storms, and registry write stalls under transient IO. Need owners + minimal timeline.
Carlos Mendes: Proposal: (1) immediate mitigations: client-side refresh damping + small token grace, registry soft-reject large batches; (2) observability: synthetic heartbeat + per-region auth metrics; (3) vendor lane: formal RCA + config ask.
Nikhil Rao: I'll take immediate mitigations. Implement token_grace_seconds=30 and per-client refresh semaphore (max_concurrent_refreshes=4). Also add registry.reject_large_batch with 429+retry-after. ETA: 48h.
Maya Patel: Who can add the synthetic and alerts? We want a 15m heartbeat that does token exchange + tiny registry write and an alert when it fails twice in 30m.
Carlos Mendes: I can wire the synthetic into smoke-harness and add an alert: synthetic.registry.heartbeat_failures > 1 in 30m -> page infra. ETA: 24h.
Nikhil Rao: I'll include metrics: auth.refresh.blocked_count and registry.write.rejected_batches in the PR.
ops-bot: Created INC-4682: "registry-token-grace-and-synthetic-heartbeat". Link: https://issues.redwood/INC-4682
Maya Patel: Vendor ask: Carlos, please open VND ticket requesting log slices for refresh spikes and confirmation if limits are per-IP or per-customer. Ask for a temporary edge-side smoothing config if possible.
Carlos Mendes: Opened VND-8209 and attached evidence bundle. Requested a joint debug session and a short-term smoothing change.
Maya Patel: Ownership summary:
- Token grace + refresh semaphore + soft-rejects: Nikhil (owner)
- Synthetic + alerts + dashboard: Carlos (owner)
- Vendor outreach & RCA: Carlos (owner)
- Tracking ticket: ops-bot (INC-4682)
Maya Patel: Timelines: synthetic + alert 24h, mitigations 48h, vendor outreach today, vendor sync Friday 11:00 PT. We'll reconvene after one week of synthetic stability to decide on long-term (regional registry replicas / token mirrors). Please paste PR/runbook links here when ready. :eyes:
